description: Germany Handelsregister Scraper. Search the German Commercial Register (Handelsregister) by company name or register number. Extract company data, officers / managing directors (Geschäftsführer) with dates of birth, capital, legal form, seat, business purpose. No official API - structured JSON for KYC, KYB & due diligence. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

exactMatch.description: Match the exact company name (genaue Firmenbezeichnung) instead of keyword containment. Reduces noise for precise lookups.
exactMatch.title: Exact company name

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching companies to return structured data for (from the first results page). 1-30.
maxResults.title: Max results

monitorKey.description: Just a label for your watchlist history, not a password or API key - it is shown masked. Optional name for this monitor's memory, e.g. 'supplier-acme'. Leave empty and the search itself is the name.
monitorKey.title: Monitor name (optional)

onlyNew.description: For scheduled checks of the same company or search. The first run returns every company found and remembers it; every later run of the SAME search returns only companies that are new to it, or whose status, name, seat, share capital or officers changed - each with changeType, changedFields and previousValues. When the register cannot serve a company's structured document on a run, its capital and officers are not compared that time (they are never reported as changed on missing data). A run with nothing new succeeds with an empty dataset and a status message, and is billed like any run. The memory is kept in your own Apify account (a key-value store named regdata-handelsregister-monitor); delete it to start again.
onlyNew.title: Monitor mode - only new or changed companies

registerNumber.description: Optional register number to narrow the search. The number on its own ("215511") or with its register type ("HRB 6684", "HRB 215511 B") - both work, and the type is selected for you. Must be combined with a company name/keyword: the portal does not allow number-only searches.
registerNumber.title: Register number (optional)

searchQuery.description: Company name or keyword(s) to search for (Schlagwörter). E.g. "Zalando SE" or "BioNTech". The register accepts at most 5 keywords - send the company name only, not a website title or description. Legal forms (GmbH, AG, KG, e.V., ...), "und", "mit" and repeated words do not count; "der", "für", "von" do. Single letters and legal forms alone are ignored: "K&F" searches for nothing - add a word from the name ("K & F Kältetechnik") or write the letters together ("KF").
searchQuery.title: Company name / keyword

name: regdata_germany_handelsregister
